title: Server
description: The host the hub runs on: services, network, kernel settings and system. Changes ask for your password again.
loadError: Could not read this from the server.

stepUp.title: Confirm with your password
stepUp.hint: Changes to the server need your password again; it is good for 5 minutes.
stepUp.tooMany: Too many wrong passwords. Try again later.
stepUp.failed: The password could not be checked.

services.restartConfirm: Restart {{name}}? Its connections drop for a moment.
services.hint: Only docker, fail2ban and the WireGuard interfaces can be restarted here.

network.name: Name
network.readOnly: Read-only: the host network is changed on the server itself.

kernel.pending: The change is live. Keep it within {{seconds}} s or the server restores the old values.
kernel.hint: A change that cuts you off is undone by itself: keep it only once the panel still works.
kernel.pendingUnknown: A change waits for confirmation. Keep it now, or the server restores the old values.

packages.title: Package updates
packages.confirmText: apt-get upgrade runs on the server. Services may restart while it runs.

reboot.title: Reboot the server
reboot.hint: Every VPN connection and the panel are down until the server is back.
reboot.confirmText: The server reboots in a few seconds. VPN connections and the panel stop until it is back.
